reviews.title: Best mouse on the market IMO - Pretty much the perfect mouse (for most) PC gamers
reviews.comment: I mostly play Overwatch as my main game, but I do a fair amount of aim trainers too (mostly aim labs), and this mouse is hands down my favorite mouse. I bought a second one for work actually (I am a programmer), so I use my mouse for work too (though I try to use the keyboard when I can). The mouse feels amazing. It is extremely light, the shape of the mouse is pleasant for the average mouse grip (mine is a hybrid palm and finger-tip grip, leaning more towards the palm and a light finger-tip touch), it keeps its charge a very long time, I never have problems keeping it charged up as a one-hour charge will last you a long time (like more than 1 week depending on your use of course, but I use more than the average gamer and I only charge about once every 1.5 to 2 weeks), the mouse also has a great sensor (up to 32k), the software for this version of the Superlight (2) offers advanced customization options like setting the lift off point (which can be high, medium, or low), the DPI can be easily set (I use 800 at 5 DPI as a DPS main (mostly Ashe and Tracer)), though you can set multiple profiles with 5 different settings each, and you can even set the x-axis and y-axis individually too. Also, the scroll wheel works perfectly. I had several Superlight Pros (the first version) where the scroll-wheel would break and I could never get it to work again, and it seemed like a software change would break it, not anything physical like slamming or dropping it, but with the Superlight version 2, I have not once had that issue and I've changed all the same software settings and I've got mad a few times and slammed it pretty hard and it hasn't broken, so I'm deeply impressed with this mouse, thus it gets the 5 stars, and I don't give those out unless I think it was earned, I give good products 4 stars, lol.
reviews.author: Brian R.

reviews.title: Perfect mouse.
reviews.comment: Awesome mouse have had it for a year and it still works perfectly. Perfect for gaming competitively or casually since its battery life will last for a few days. Feels super quiet with minimal lag and has a dongle so you can have the true perfect connectivity. Absolutely worth the money for it if you want to play anything competitive.

reviews.title: Logitech superlight 2 DEX
reviews.comment: Mouse is incredible. Very lightweight and responsive.  Battery life is also great. Also really like the coating on the mouse.
reviews.author: Cody

reviews.title: Pretty Sweet Gaming Mouse
reviews.comment:
I've had it for 4 1/2 months now, great feeling mouse, very responsive and fast, it looks sick in my setup, and I've only had to charge it about 2 times since I got it so good battery life. Having to download G Hub to configure it for the first time I'd say was fairly easy but I recommend configuring it, turning on on board memory mode, and forgetting the software. Also about 3 months into having it I spilled a whole cup of water on it and spent like 20 minutes getting all the liquid out of the mouse and a month later it still works like it's brand new lol.
For the price, I'd only recommend it to some, but overall pretty sweet mouse.
reviews.author: Tildon M.

reviews.title: Priced well for the quality
reviews.comment: Lives up to its name, it is ...superlight. Easy setup, download Logitech G HUB and install the drivers, charges super fast and is silky smooth. I got the right handed one and it fits my hand perfectly. It is pretty pricey, but I feel like for a higher end mouse it was priced well. Movement is crisp and build quality is top notch.
